data.hypothesis: Capping the static OpenMP team by a generic 512-options-per-worker grain may reduce parallel overhead for intermediate workloads while still using the full passed thread budget for sufficiently large work. Unlike a serial-only cutoff, this tests a smaller team at the crossover region; no gain is assumed, and the controller should measure overhead, varied-input correctness, and output coverage.

memory_lessons.applicability: The aggregate results support retaining a serial path and a bounded parallel path, but do not identify a best crossover because no comparable per-size timings are available.
memory_lessons.claim: Three prior T1 OpenMP candidates were valid and correct, with aggregate means of about 1.408, 1.430, and 1.450 ms. Those aggregate differences do not establish which cutoff performs best at any particular size.
memory_lessons.next_experiment: Measure this team-size cap against the serial and prior parallel candidates by valid size and thread budget, especially near the serial/parallel boundary; do not infer crossover from aggregate means.

data.notes: No commands or measurements were run here. The candidate writes one distinct result per loop iteration and requests no more OpenMP workers than the supplied positive thread budget. The 512-options grain is independent of published input sizes; official measurement and varied-input checks remain with the controller.
transformations: Factored the unchanged per-option Black-Scholes calculation into a shared inline helper for serial and parallel execution.
Added a static-scheduled OpenMP outer loop with a team size capped by both the passed thread budget and n/512.
Retained a serial path for nonpositive sizes, budgets of one or less, and workloads too small to support two workers at the selected grain.

model_reported.name: conduire-experience-optimisation
model_reported.summary: Used prior aggregate results to choose a contrasting team-size cap rather than asserting a cutoff winner; retained serial execution when the budget or grain does not support at least two workers.

model_reported.name: inspecter-environnement
model_reported.summary: No additional target details were needed for this source-level trial; it leaves the frozen environment unchanged and caps the requested OpenMP team using the passed thread count.

model_reported.name: consulter-documentation-technique
model_reported.summary: The static OpenMP loop mechanism has already been exercised by valid candidates in the supplied evidence; this experiment does not rely on a new API or hardware feature.

model_reported.name: evaluer-performances
model_reported.summary: Compared only the reported aggregate measurements, noted the lack of crossover timings, and left performance and correctness claims for this candidate to official controller evaluation.
